tasks.label: Briefcase: 1. build .app
tasks.detail: STEP 1 (default build task, Cmd+Shift+B): scaffold the bundle on first run (briefcase create), then compile pdf-md-anonymizer.app. Symlinks build/ + dist/ out of iCloud and pre-strips numpy .so signatures.

tasks.label: Briefcase: 2. package .dmg
tasks.detail: STEP 2 (optional): build the .app (step 1), ad-hoc codesign it, then hdiutil-pack a distributable .dmg with the .app, Applications symlink, First Launch.txt, and Third party notices.txt. Output: dist/PDF-MD Anonymizer-<version>.dmg.

tasks.label: Briefcase: clean rebuild
tasks.detail: Use when step 1 does not pick up changes (e.g. after a dependency bump): wipes the cached scaffold and re-runs briefcase create + build from scratch. Slower than step 1 but guaranteed fresh.

tasks.label: Briefcase: run .app
tasks.detail: Launch the built .app directly. We bypass `uvx briefcase run macOS` because it fails on this repo: the build/ symlink (iCloud workaround) means `open -n` resolves to ~/.briefcase-out/..., but briefcase searches for a process whose cmdline starts with the symlinked path — paths never match, app_pid is None, and briefcase exits with code 200 even though the .app is running. Launching the Mach-O binary directly bonds the terminal to the app: Python stderr (tracebacks, our _log lines) streams to this terminal, and Ctrl-C kills the app. Run step 1 first.
